title: Connectedness below and across its joining floor
expected: Below 0.45 there should be no synthesis joins. Above the floor, eligible pairs may join; stroke counts need not be monotone because branch-dependent randomness also changes.
input: Real stored Dylan glyph profile; text hello world hello; seed 17; 4 mm/x-height. Identity calibration isolates local changes.
qualification: Single-candidate stage isolation; no repair. Fixed seed does not keep random consumption fixed after branch changes.
